'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta''' was a post-reset ([[Open]]) side event at the 2014 European Championship, 12–14 September 2014. [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] finished 1st. The main European Championship that weekend used the pre-reset pool; [[Casper Jørgensen]] is the published European Champion for 2014.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 12–14 September 2014
* '''Winner:''' [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]]
